knobChangelog.desc: CV ceiling 0.6→1.4, offCV 0.18→0.45, POS_CV totals raised — variance model rebuilt
Soft projection ceiling scaled by team Vegas total (was flat 11 DK)
RBI_MULT/RUNS_MULT flattened — slots 5-9 raised toward the heart (35-slate backtest). Chris dates the deploy Jun 7-9; cutoff seeded at the latest plausible date.
W4: 0.5+0.5·(vt/4) → 0.4+0.6·(vt/4). Elite (5.0+) band still +1.00 under-projected across 9 post-W3 slates (n=175) — restores ~half the differential the W3 dampening over-removed.
P1: baseIP 4.85 → 4.65 (≈ -0.45 DK pts). Pitchers -1.02 mean over-projection confirmed in both windows (15 slates / 9 since 06-01, n=160); half-gap at formula level, rest stays with biasMult.

Heart (3-4) re-emerged over-projected -1.0 pts (-12%) across the 54-slate windowed backtest (orderMult.flatten raised 5-9 but LEFT 3-4 untouched). RBI_MULT 3: 1.15→1.08, 4: 1.28→1.20 — half the gap at the formula; the rest is carried by the new batOrderBiasMult sim corrector. RUNS_MULT[3-4] graded clean → untouched. Chris: set date to the actual deploy date if it slips past 06-19.

knobChangelog.anchor: mlb/index.html ~L1844-1865 (v35.5 Est IP usage blend + v35.6 hitter PA split)
knobChangelog.desc: Est IP blends the pitcher's real per-start usage (w5 last-5, weight n/(n+2), floor 4.0→1.5 with ≥2 starts, ceiling recent-max+0.5); hitter starter/pen PA split keys off opposing SP estIP/9. RETRO-ADDED 2026-07-06 — the entry was missed at deploy time, so pre/post bias panels mixed eras. Graded 7/2-7/5 (4 slates): ace chronic −2.56 under-projection RESOLVED (+0.86, per-slate mixed); mid +1.98 / value +2.27 apparent over-projection on 3/4 slates — CONFOUNDED with a ~2.5pt colder actuals window; decision deferred to the windowed pit_mid/pit_value biasMult (anchors 2026-07-05).

knobChangelog.anchor: mlb/index.html worker (offSig/adjSig/gameEnv/teamBias × depScale) + fieldScoreCal fit in mlb-sim-calibration-build.js
knobChangelog.desc: v37: the worker's SHARED dependence factors are scaled by a fitted depScale (sim winner-minus-cashline spread vs realized DK contests — expectedBest ran 243-250 vs realized winners 200-226, chronic over 3 days). Shrinking shared σ trims every player's TOTAL marginal CV a few % — the windowed stdevMult views must re-window from this date to re-absorb the residual.

v59.4 fix #6c (7/2 review bug #3): BA (per-AB) was consumed as a per-PA hit rate — walk-heavy hitters carried ~+0.2-0.6 phantom singles pts. hitRate now = ba × (1 − bbRate − 0.008 HBP). Also corrects xH and the derived splash-stats props.

v59.4 fix #6 (7/2 review #6, landed jointly with hitterSingles.perPA): the BA/OBP/ISO shrinkage target gains the league platoon delta for the batter-hand × pitcher-hand cell, PA-weighted from the uploaded vs-hand pools per upload (thin cells <1500 PA → 0; clamps ±0.030/±0.040 ISO). Small-split hitters stop inheriting a hand-blind target; big-split hitters ~unmoved.

Joint pitcher bundle: DK win bonus winProb*4 → winProb*P5*0.855*4 (P5 = last-10 P(IP≥5) shrunk k=6 to lg 0.690; λ=P(W)/(P(teamWin)·P(IP≥5)), fit 7/24 n=3,058 starts, ≈ −0.82 DK) + estIP +0.35 level add pre-estBF (measured −0.39 IP vs trailing; the K gap is the IP gap via estBF; ≈ +0.86 DK with knock-ons). Net ≈ +0.04 by construction. FD win term untouched (follow-up). See scratchpad/replay/pitcher-bundle/SPEC.md — gates: |bias|≤1.0 over ≥8 slates, pit ρ≥0.30, ipRatio/kRatio 0.93-1.07 by 8 slates; single-commit revert of all three parts together.

v59.4 fix #4a (7/2 review bug #4): vegasER dropped its parkRunFactor multiplier — oppVegas already prices the venue, so park was double-counted (Coors-class arms ~1.4 DK over-penalized). Park now adjusts only the park-neutral skillER, dampened to 40% (hitter-engine precedent). Neutral parks unchanged.

fieldScoreCal.note: depScale for the sim worker's SHARED factors (team offense/adjacency/game env/team bias). d<1 shrinks joint stack tails ~d² while calibrated idio marginals barely move. Flip status to 'off' to revert (client falls back to ×1).

gppRoiCal.note: Predicted→realized GPP-ROI truth. Per-slate tables journaled durably in mlb-gpp-roi-journal.json; this rollup is cross-slate MEDIANS of per-slate stats — picks are never pooled across slates. Display + evFloor-threshold consumer ONLY (the map is monotone; selection ordering is untouched). levKick: human sets 0 here to retire the 0.35 leverage kicker once levKickEvidence.selReady.

projDivCal.note: SPAGS vs Stokastic team-Σ projection vs realized team hitter DKFP-Σ. rhoTop (top-half-board, each predictor's own board) is THE tilt metric; all-team rho is context only. Per-slate rows durable in mlb-proj-div-journal.json; this rollup is medians of per-slate stats — teams never pooled across slates.
